target.title: fix(discord): guard parseDiscordGatewayInfoBody JSON.parse against malformed API responses
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`extensions/discord/src/monitor/gateway-metadata.ts:159` calls bare `JSON.parse(body)` in `parseDiscordGatewayInfoBody()` when parsing the Discord `/gateway/bot` API response. A compromised or misconfigured Discord API endpoint returning malformed JSON would throw a raw `SyntaxError` instead of a descriptive validation error.

This follows the same pattern as merged D4 JSON.parse guard PRs: #97889 (discord api.ts), #97973 (matrix), #97999 (twilio), #98073 (signal), #98587 (slack), #98800 (gateway live-helpers).

## Changes

- `extensions/discord/src/monitor/gateway-metadata.ts`: wrap `JSON.parse(body)` in try/catch, throw descriptive `Error("Discord gateway info body is not valid JSON.")` instead of raw SyntaxError
- `extensions/discord/src/monitor/gateway-metadata.test.ts`: 3 new tests (malformed JSON → descriptive error, valid JSON → parsed correctly, empty body → descriptive error)
- `test/_proof_discord_gateway_metadata_json_guard.mts`: standalone proof script that imports and calls the real `parseDiscordGatewayInfoBody()` directly

Label: bugfix | merge-risk: 🟢 minimal | AI-assisted

## Evidence

### Standalone proof script (L2) — calls the ACTUAL exported function

```
$ node --import tsx test/_proof_discord_gateway_metadata_json_guard.mts

[1] malformed gateway info body → descriptive Error
  PASS  throws Error (not SyntaxError)
  PASS  message includes "not valid JSON"

[2] valid gateway info body → returns correctly
  PASS  no error thrown
  PASS  returns object
  PASS  url preserved
  PASS  shards preserved

[3] empty string → throws Error
  PASS  throws Error for empty body

[4] valid JSON but wrong schema → schema validation error
  PASS  throws Error for schema mismatch
  PASS  message is schema error (not JSON parse error)

==================================================
  Passed: 9  Failed: 0  Total: 9
==================================================
```

Before (current main): `JSON.parse("NOT JSON {{{")` → raw `SyntaxError` propagates uncaught
After (this PR): `parseDiscordGatewayInfoBody("NOT JSON {{{")` → descriptive `Error: Discord gateway info body is not valid JSON.`

### Call chain

`fetchDiscordGatewayInfo()` → HTTP GET `https://discord.com/api/v10/gateway/bot` → `response.text()` → `parseDiscordGatewayInfoBody(body)` — called during gateway startup to fetch Discord gateway connection info.

### Negative control (L3)

Stashing the try/catch and reverting to bare `JSON.parse(body)` causes the proof script to fail with raw `SyntaxError`, confirming the fix is real and the test is not a tautology.
